classification: post_hoc integration refinement motivated by prospective U01
observed_failure: U01-ON naturally produced an adopted bridge and passed the provider-side bash-search gate, but relevance_split enforcement remained unreachable downstream.
refinement: When trajectory_search_relevance is already enabled and the trajectory context contains an Adopted bridge identifiers marker, treat the established search provenance as sufficient to attempt search relevance_split directly. If relevance_split abstains, preserve the existing routing fallback.
rationale: The adopted marker can only arise after a producing search command has been associated with the current output and a current-query identifier has intersected the frozen prior trajectory bridge set. Requiring output-shape search detection again is therefore a redundant downstream gate.
constraints: do not rerun U01 or any benchmark agent
do not alter the frozen 89da result
use only already-captured U01-ON exact inbound requests
make no change to bridge extraction, ranking, adoption semantics, or preservation scoring
if direct relevance_split abstains, retain prior fallback behavior
classify all resulting evidence as post-hoc mechanism evidence, not unseen validation

offline_evaluation.primary_metric: whether the same adopted-bridge unit reaches search > relevance_split
